issues: Rows 5-8: table cells list multiple indicator/range pairs and multiple objects per numbered row; each indicator+range combination was split into its own JSON row per the schema's rule, repeating norm_doc/object. Row 10 groups three sub-objects (Вода открытых водоёмов, Вода бассейна, Сточная вода) each with its own E. coli range under one numbered row; split accordingly with object narrowed to the specific sub-object for each. Ranges containing '9,9x10^n' (exponent notation, printed with superscript n) were kept as free text in range_to/range_from since they are not plain decimal numbers. Row 11 has no object listed in the source (merged visually with row 10's object cell but not repeated in the table) so object is null. No ТР ТС section headings appear anywhere in this document; the bold full-width rows are lab address lines, not ТР ТС sections, so tr_section is null on every row per the rules. No rotated or illegible pages.
